meta.name: meeting-insights-analyzer
meta.description: Analyzes meeting transcripts and recordings to uncover behavioral patterns, communication insights, and actionable feedback. Identifies when you avoid conflict, use filler words, dominate conversations, or miss opportunities to listen. Perfect for professionals seeking to improve their communication and leadership skills.

copy.tagline: 分析会议记录,发现沟通模式与改进机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望从会议中获取行为洞察,提升沟通效果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze meeting transcripts to uncover communication patterns and growth opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to gain behavioral insights from meetings and improve your communication skills

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能分析会议记录，找出你的沟通模式，比如是否回避冲突、使用口头禅、说话过多或倾听不足，并给出带时间戳的具体改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提供会议记录文件（如 .txt、.vtt）并请求分析时触发，例如要求找出回避冲突的时刻或统计说话比例。

say.text: 分析这个文件夹里所有会议记录，告诉我哪些地方我回避了冲突。
say.note: Claude 会扫描文件并输出具体例子。

say.text: 对比我上个月和这个月的会议，看看我的倾听能力有没有进步。
say.note: Claude 会生成对比报告，显示变化趋势。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze meeting transcripts to identify communication patterns such as conflict avoidance, filler words, dominating conversations, or poor listening, and provide timestamped, actionable feedback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide meeting transcript files (e.g., .txt, .vtt) and request analysis, such as asking to find instances of conflict avoidance or speaking ratio.

say_en.text: Analyze all meeting transcripts in this folder and tell me where I avoided conflict.
say_en.note: Claude scans files and outputs specific examples.

say_en.text: Compare my meetings from last month to this month to see if my listening improved.
say_en.note: Claude generates a comparative report showing trends.
